components.name: Segmented control

components.name: Activity status tag

narrative.overview: A restrained desktop activity system with shared photographic page field and quiet white working surfaces.

rules.name: Shared-Surface Rule
rules.body: Related routes reuse the same background, search, cards, tags, typography, and focus language.

rules.name: Stable-Gutter Rule
rules.body: Full-width headers and fixed content columns preserve the plaza page field.

rules.name: Quiet-Lift Rule
rules.body: Depth appears only on interaction or layered content.

dos: Reuse plaza components across related routes.
Reveal hover actions for keyboard focus too.
donts: Create a separate gray visual theme.
Move list rows to reveal information.
